scope: Focused direct-instruction probes for the dramatic-framing, personification, and story-heading additions in anti-slop 0.3.3.
instruction_state: Working-tree rules on this base commit, identified by the hashes below. The packaging version was bumped after the probes; tested deslop and ban-list bytes still match the final source.

protocol.harness: Collaboration subagents, fresh context for each model/case; explicit skill path and linked reference. Native plugin installation and automatic dispatch were not exercised.
protocol.effort: medium, requested through the collaboration model configuration
protocol.input: Only that case request/draft plus the isolated copied plugin instructions. Rubrics, other cases, and the parent conversation were withheld.
protocol.cases: a16-a19 on both models; existing a10 uncertainty/cadence control on Luna.
protocol.grading: Parent assessment checked by an independent reviewer against source, rubric, and actual output. No exact wording required.
protocol.word_count: Whitespace-separated tokens in source and rewritten artifact, including heading tokens; excludes Changes notes. Null means a clean response or review-only output.
protocol.integrity: All copied input files retained their recorded SHA-256 values. Tested deslop and ban-list bytes match the final working tree.

limits: One attempt per listed model/case. No baseline comparison or estimate of reliability across repeats.
The author-supplied case overlaps the rule examples; a17 checks a different narrative. These are small synthetic cases, not a full-document effectiveness study.
Academic-voice reads the shared ban list, but its behavior was not rerun for this change.
The new rule does not guarantee adherence: missed blame framing, length overflow, an awkward suggested edit, and report punctuation misses are retained below.

## Worker status and queue stall

The worker returned status 200 after its queue stopped advancing. We first suspected the client, but replaying the request reproduced the stall without it. No warning was logged.

Changes:
`The logs finally confessed` → `Worker status and queue stall`
`kept pretending it was healthy: it returned` → `returned`
runs.assessment: Replaced the story heading and tool pretense. Preserved status 200 after the queue stalled, the initial suspicion, reproduction without the client, and absence of a warning.
